title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi on 06.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 05/10/2026
on 06.10.2026.

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 05/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that ;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav Trivedi would not be available
on 06.10.2026.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Ms. Justice Nisha M.
Thakore) would take up the matters notified in the Cause
list of Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Pranav
Trivedi.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
